title: Connect to the database — db_connection
text: Opens connection SQL Server database via ODBC. Accepts either pre-built connection string, individual connection parameters assembled one automatically.

title: Connect to the database — db_connection
code: db_connection(   connection_string = NULL,   driver = "SQL Server",   server = "noufamesql04",   database = "FISH_MASTER",   ... )

title: Connect to the database — db_connection
text: connection_string complete ODBC connection string. supplied, used -arguments ignored. Defaults NULL, case string built driver, server database. driver ODBC driver name. Defaults "SQL Server", generic driver name available platforms without needing specific driver version installed. server Server hostname. Defaults "noufamesql04". database Database name. Defaults "FISH_MASTER". ... Additional named arguments passed DBI::dbConnect().

what: Plot ACE catch trends by year — plot_ace
title: Plot ACE catch trends by year — plot_ace
text: Takes output sum_ace() plots total catch (t) line year, optionally coloured /faceted another grouping column still present data (e.g. OCEAN_CODE, FLAG_CODE, GEAR_CODE, SP_CODE). Data re-aggregated internally YY, colour_by facet_by lines always clean, regardless grouping columns remain data.

title: Plot ACE catch trends by year — plot_ace
code: plot_ace(data, colour_by = NULL, facet_by = NULL, facet_scales = "fixed")

title: Plot ACE catch trends by year — plot_ace
text: data tibble returned sum_ace(), containing least YY sum_catch_mt. colour_by Optional. Bare column name colour lines (e.g. SP_CODE). Defaults NULL (single line, colour grouping). facet_by Optional. Bare column name facet (e.g. OCEAN_CODE). Defaults NULL (facetting). facet_scales Passed ggplot2::facet_wrap()'s scales argument facet_by supplied. Defaults "fixed".

title: Plot ACE catch trends by year — plot_ace
Plot ACE catch trends by year — plot_ace
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ ace_output <- sum_ace(ocean = "WX", species = c("YFT", "SKJ"))  # Single line, total catch by year plot_ace(ace_output)  # Coloured by species plot_ace(ace_output, colour_by = SP_CODE)  # Coloured by species, faceted by ocean, free y-scales per panel plot_ace(ace_output, colour_by = SP_CODE, facet_by = OCEAN_CODE, facet_scales = "free_y") } # }

what: Summarise ACE catch by ocean, flag, gear, species and year — sum_ace
title: Summarise ACE catch by ocean, flag, gear, species and year — sum_ace
text: Queries ACE database returns total catch (metric tonnes), summed ocean, flag, gear, species year. filter left NULL (default) applied, values field included.

title: Summarise ACE catch by ocean, flag, gear, species and year — sum_ace
code: sum_ace(   ocean = NULL,   flag = NULL,   gear = NULL,   species = NULL,   year = NULL,   group_species = FALSE,   group_flags = FALSE,   group_gears = FALSE )

title: Summarise ACE catch by ocean, flag, gear, species and year — sum_ace
text: ocean character vector ocean codes filter (e.g. "WX"), NULL (default) include oceans. flag character vector flag codes filter (e.g. c("ID", "VN")), NULL (default) include flags. gear character vector gear codes filter (e.g. "L" longline), NULL (default) include gears. species character vector species codes filter (e.g. c("YFT", "SKJ")), NULL (default) include species. year numeric character vector years filter (e.g. 2024:2025), NULL (default) include years. group_species Boolean. TRUE, return combined catch across species specified

title: Summarise ACE catch by ocean, flag, gear, species and year — sum_ace
text: tibble::tibble() columns OCEAN_CODE, FLAG_CODE, GEAR_CODE, SP_CODE, YY sum_catch_mt, one row per unique combination ocean, flag, gear, species year present (filtered) data. Note: grouping arguements (e.g., group_species group_flags) set TRUE, columns omitted output tibble.

title: Summarise ACE catch by ocean, flag, gear, species and year — sum_ace
text: Assumes FLAG_CODE column ace.A_ACE. instead lives ace.A_ACE_CATCH another joined table, update SQL accordingly.

title: Summarise ACE catch by ocean, flag, gear, species and year — sum_ace
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Filter on everything sum_ace(   ocean   = "WX",   flag    = c("ID", "VN"),   gear    = "L",   species = c("YFT", "SKJ"),   year    = 2024:2025 )  # No filters at all — all oceans, flags, gears, species and years sum_ace() } # }
